name: MOSS-Image
format: ComfyUI API-format prompt graph: {node_id: {class_type, inputs}}. POST it as the `prompt` field of POST /prompt.
model: MOSS-Image SFT (OpenMOSS), ComfyUI repack Comfy-Org/MOSS-Image (int8 convrot weights, w4a8 GPTQ Qwen3.5 9B text encoder, small FLUX.2 VAE)
source: Comfy-Org's template image_moss_image_t2i (workflow_templates 0.11.89) converted to the API format: its files, sampling (25 steps, cfg 2.5, er_sde, simple) and recommended negative prompt, with its two switches as shipped: skip-layer guidance off, so the KSampler takes the UNETLoader's model directly. Its prompt upsampler (TextGenerate on the same text encoder) is left out because AutoPaper's writer already composes a full caption. The graph that painted the recorded request on the user's Mac.
negative_prompt: Node 5 holds the negative prompt the MOSS-Image user guide recommends (nsfw, worst quality, bad anatomy, watermark, jpeg artifact), as Comfy-Org's template does.
notes: Native MOSS-Image support (CLIPLoader type 'moss_image', comfy/ldm/moss_image) landed in ComfyUI master on 2026-10-16 (PR #17095): AutoPaper offers this model only when the server lists that type.
The w4a8 GPTQ text encoder runs on Apple silicon through comfy-kitchen's eager w4a8_int8_linear.

Width and height must be multiples of 16. AutoPaper asks for at most 2048 a side and 2,965,760 pixels: the FLUX.2 VAE decodes 2048x1440 on Apple silicon and fails at 2048x1456 and 2048x2048 ('MPSGraph does not support tensor dims larger than INT_MAX'), the same bound as the 8x VAEs (core/src/providers/comfyui.rs MODEL_LIMITS). The model card's range is 0.25 to 4 megapixels.
MOSS-Image renders text well; AutoPaper's prompts ask for none, so it paints scenes like the others.
filename_prefix 'autopaper/wallpaper' makes ComfyUI write into output/autopaper/.
